title: Now that Character.AI is going bankrupt, what happens to all of its users’ data?
slides: Character.AI is going bankrupt — where does your data go?
Its servers hold millions of intimate user conversations
Bankruptcy courts may sell that data to the highest bidder
You can request deletion now, but it may be too late
Check the privacy policy before your next confession
thread_text:
1. Your deepest secrets for sale

Character.AI is bankrupt. Courts may auction millions of intimate chats to pay off creditors. Your data is the asset.

2. What exactly is on those servers

Millions of private conversations, emotional confessions, and personal details. None of it was written for an audience.

3. The fine print you missed

Most users never read the privacy policy. It likely allows data transfer in bankruptcy. You agreed to this.

4. You can delete — but is it too late?

Requests work only if the servers haven't already been frozen by the court. Timing matters more than you think.

5. Before your next confession

Check the privacy policy first. Ask: what happens to my data if this company goes under? Then decide what you share.

instagram.caption:
Millions of private chats you thought were just between you and a bot could soon be auctioned off to pay creditors. 💾

Character.AI is going bankrupt, and its servers hold intimate conversations users never wrote for an audience.

Bankruptcy courts can sell that data to the highest bidder.

You can request deletion now, but if the servers are already frozen by the court, it may be too late. ⏳

If you've ever typed something personal into an AI companion, that text is now a company asset.

Ask yourself: what would you share differently if you knew it could end up on an auction block? 🤔
